title: Pomegranate: modeled ₹1,329/qtl left, Kangra (Baijnath) → Una
summary: January 2025: reported pomegranate prices at Kangra (Baijnath) and Una imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 85% of 26 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹1,329 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 112 same-variety market pairs screened for pomegranate in January 2025; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (Medium) at both markets; sale matched to the first Una report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: January 2025
scenes.caption: Kangra (Baijnath) (Himachal Pradesh) and Una (Himachal Pradesh) both reported pomegranate prices for the same variety and grade (Medium) on 26 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Kangra (Baijnath) reported a median ₹11,750 per quintal. Una reported a median ₹14,000 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹2,500/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹2,500 per quintal, and Una was dearer on 100% of days.

scenes.headline: 93 km by road
scenes.caption: 93 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~2 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹20/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹1,113 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹377 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Una report, the rule selects 23 of 26 modeled shipping days. 21 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹1,329 per quintal (₹610 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Pomegranate route from Kangra (Baijnath) to Una was positive on 85% of matched days in January 2025. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹132,900, or ₹61,000 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to pomegranate
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹20/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Pomegranate route from Kangra (Baijnath) to Una was positive on 85% of matched days in January 2025. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹132,900, or ₹61,000 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

title: Pomegranate: modeled ₹1,820/qtl left, Naraingarh → Thanesar
summary: October 2025: reported pomegranate prices at Naraingarh and Thanesar imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 95% of 19 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹1,820 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 76 same-variety market pairs screened for pomegranate in October 2025; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (Pomogranate, Medium) at both markets; sale matched to the first Thanesar report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: 74 km by road

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
